objective: Enter the vehicle configurator, proceed through the configuration steps using default choices, and continue online: click the final completion control (e.g. a 'Continue Online' control, or an equivalent control in the page's own language). Confirm completion however the site itself signals it -- reaching the basket/checkout-entry page, or the completion control being clicked, or the site's own configuration-finished analytics event firing are all equally valid confirmation. Return the final URL reached.

successCriteria.description: The vehicle configurator has been entered: configuration controls (e.g. trim, colour, options) are visible on the page.
The completion control (for example a 'Continue Online' button, or an equivalent control in the page's own language) was actually clicked -- not merely a right-looking page reached some other way.
The site's own configuration-finished analytics event fired.
